decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line close to the core offer, launched while industry turnover is growing and the firm is hiring, it likely meets aspirations, and the firm has the slack to carry it while it matures.

The organic poultry snack fits the firm's stated organic expansion and has its own web page, so there is no clear shortfall to trigger problemistic search, though niche snack formats are the most likely to be pruned.
The premium sharing snack line uses the firm's existing salami capabilities and has its own web page, and growing demand plus organisational slack give the firm little reason to drop it soon.
